title: The world is reacting to the Democrats' midterm elections victory
description: From Kyiv to Moscow, and Tehran to Tel Aviv, all eyes were on the Democrats big win as foreign powers weigh how a flipped Congress will affect international relations.

title: Democrats seize full control of Congress. And, which candidates made history last night
description: Democrats have won the House and the Senate, taking full control of Congress for the first time since 2023. And history was made in several states. Here's what happened last night.

title: 6 takeaways from Democrats' big wave on election night
description: The magnitude of the Democrats' outcome was always a possibility, but the depth and breadth of their victories were jaw-dropping.

title: Eric Holder on how the GOP's redistricting efforts affected the midterms
description: NPR's Michel Martin speaks to Eric Holder, chairman of the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, about how mid-decade redistricting affected the results of the midterms.

title: Votes are still being counted to see who will represent Mississippi in the Senate
description: Votes are still being counted to determine who will represent Mississippi in the U.S. Senate. Democrat Scott Colom was only a handful of votes ahead of Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith early Wednesday.

title: A look at results for state legislatures around the country
description: NPR's Michel Martin speaks to West Chester University political science professor John Kennedy about the balance of state legislatures as midterm election results come in.

title: Midterm results become a referendum on Trump's record
description: President Trump's touted his record at rallies across the country before the midterms. But voters didn't agree with his assessment on the state of the economy.

title: These 9 candidates for governor made history in the 2026 election
description: Voters on Tuesday elected the nation's first Black woman governor and the nation's first Native American woman governor.

title: Hakeem Jeffries is poised to become the first Black speaker of the House
description: As speaker, the New York Democrat would be second in the presidential line of succession, after the vice president. He has vowed to focus on affordability and holding the administration accountable.

title: Trump casts blame on others after Democrats sweep midterms
description: President Trump lashed out on his social media platform Truth Social Tuesday night, blaming others for losses in key races across the country.
